If sentiment is >0.5 in the last 3 days and forecast is trending up, reduce forecast by 1–2% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is <0.3 and forecast is trending down, increase forecast by 1–2% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is 0.3–0.67 and forecast is flat, adjust forecast to match recent 5-day average for late horizon (16–30 days).  
If sentiment spikes to 1.0 after a downward trend, reverse the last 3 forecast points upward by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon.  
If sentiment drops to 0.0 after a peak, reduce forecast by 1–3% for mid horizon if true price has already fallen.  
If sentiment is negative and forecast is above recent 10-day high, cut forecast by 2–4% for late horizon to avoid overcorrection.
